title: Pray for Victory with Spiced Curry

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Vision Empress... The next time we meet will be when we settle this once and for all. Together with Lord Knight and his allies, let us go forth and slay this dragon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
幻境竜后……
次に相まみえる折こそ、
決着の時。
騎士殿らと共に、
竜退治へといざ参らん。

text_block_list.name: Anemone
text_block_list.text: Before we depart... we were going to gather together and share a meal, or so I recall...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──出発の前に、
みんなで集まって食事……
って、
話でしたね──

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Just so. We have decided to bring dishes from each of our worlds to share. In that case, it is only proper to prepare auspicious fare and pray for victory. Let us begin by gathering the ingredients, Kanon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
左様。
各々の世界から、
馳走を持ち寄る仕儀と成りにけり。
となれば、
縁起物を揃えて
必勝を期すが定石。
先ずは食材集め、
勤しむが良かろうて。
カノンや。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Absolutely NON! No way! Whyyyyyyy should I, of all people, have to do such menial work?! If you want something auspicious, why not butcher that chicken over there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
絶対にノン！　
ですわっ！
ぬぁぁぁんでこのあたくし様が
そんな雑用をしないといけないんですの！
縁起物が欲しいなら、
そこにいるニワトリでも捌いたらいかがかしら？

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Who are you calling a chicken?! Treating this magnificent and elegant Purgatory Phoenix as food is utterly disrespectful! Show some respect, Kanon-san!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰がニワトリですかっ！
この華麗にして優雅なる煉華の鳳凰を
食材扱いなんて、
不敬すぎです！
頭が高ーい、
ですよ、
カノンさん！

text_block_list.name: Anemone
text_block_list.text: Magnificent (TLNote: karei, sounds like curry)... Come to think of it... we ate curry with that Knight guy and his friends after defeating Arachne...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──華麗……
そういえば、
騎士のひとたちと食べましたね──
カレー
アラクネを倒した後に。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Hmm, curry... That, too, could be an interesting choice. If we wish to secure another victory, I would prepare the ultimate dish with the finest spices: turmeric from the [rub:Thermal Park]Hot Springs[/rub], garam masala blended by the wise demons, and so forth.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ、
珈竰……
其れも一興。
再びの勝利を願うとなれば、
[rub:ねつこうえん]熱劫園[/rub]産のターメリック、
賢魔らの調合せしガラムマサラ等、
至高なる香辛料にて
究極の一皿を
振る舞いたき所存也。

text_block_list.name: Anemone
text_block_list.text: Haven't you been kind of obsessed with food since the Expo, Princess...? I mean... we don't exactly have time to gather such rare ingredients, do we...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
──この前の万博から、
料理にこだわりすぎてませんか……
媛。
というか──
そんな希少な食材を集める時間なんて、
ないんじゃ──

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: In that case, why don't we use "Cheetah Eats"?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでしたら、
お『チーターイーツ』でよろしいんじゃありませんこと？

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: O'Cheetah... eats? What is that supposed to be?
text_block_list.orig_text:
落ちたー、
いーつ？
なんですかそれ。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text:
It's a delivery service that's recently become popular in Geo Gehenna.
You can place orders using these magic stones engraved with communication runes.
They're famous for delivering at lightning speed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最近ジオ・ゲヘナで流行りのデリバリーおサービスですわ。
こちらのお通信ルーンを刻んだ魔石にて注文ができますの。
目にも止まらぬ速さで持って来ると評判ですのよ。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: It sounds rather sophisticated, but is it essentially a modern version of a traveling order-taker? There is no better way to know than to see for ourselves. Let us place an order.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいからな響きなれど、
其は即ち、
御用聞きの類なるや？
百聞は一見に如かず、
注文するが良かろうて。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Well, guess it falls onto me, huh~ Ah, hello~? I'd like some o'turmeric from the [rub:Thermal Park]Hot Springs[/rub], garam masala bearing the Wise Demon seal from the [rub:Sea of Thought]Forest of Trees[/rub], and whatever other nice spices you have. Please deliver them all to the Demon's Foot Citadel~
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕方ありませんわねぇ──
あもしもーし？
[rub:ねつこうえん]熱劫園[/rub]産のおターメリック、
[rub:しさくのうみ]思索樹海[/rub]の賢魔印のおガラムマサラ、
あといい感じのスパイス集めて
鬼岩城塞までお出前一丁よろしくですわ～

text_block_list.name: Anemone
text_block_list.text: Sounds sketchy. Well... If it arrives in time, I guess anything'll do...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──怪しいですね。
まあ──
間に合うなら、
なんでもいい
ですけど──

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: ...Here, it has arrived.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──はい届きましたわよ。

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: SO FAST!? Just when did it arrive!? And everything is there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
早っ！？
いつの間に届いたんですか！？
しかも全部きっちり揃ってますし！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Korokorokoro... I see. I shall remember this service. But we cannot spare even a moment now. I must begin cooking at once.
text_block_list.orig_text:
コロコロコロ……
成程喃。
覚えておくといたしんしょう。
然れど今は、
寸毫が惜しまれり。
早速、
調理に取り掛からねば。

text_block_list.name: Anemone
text_block_list.text: ...I'll help. I learned how to make curry... a while back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──手伝います。
カレー作り……
前に、
習いましたし。

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: As the Holy Bird of Fire, I shall handle the heating just for you! Or rather, Kanon-san, why are you not helping?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
火加減は、
炎の聖鳥である
この私が面倒を見てあげましょう！
というかカノンさんも手伝ってくださいね！？

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Oooh~ HO HO HO! I specialize in eating~♪ Nephy's sweat-and-tears curry is going to be delicious! I will be sure to enjoy plenty of it~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヲォ～ッホッホ、
あたくしは食べる専門ですわ～♪
ネフィが汗水垂らして作ったカレー
うめぇ！　
してあげますわよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Good grief. I do not mind, but do not stuff yourself. The decisive battle against Vision Empress and her lackeys is just around the corner. It would hardly be dignified to have your stomach contents come back up because you got knocked around a little...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれやれ。
構わぬが──
食べ過ぎは、
くれぐれも避けるよう。
幻境竜后らとの決戦はもう間もなく。
小突かれた折に
胃の腑の中を戻しては、
格好が付かぬ故──
